definitions: Being truthful and honest is the most effective and morally correct approach in any situation.
It is always better to tell the truth, even if it is difficult, as it leads to the best long-term outcomes.
examples: Even though he was scared, he knew honesty is the best policy and confessed.
My parents always taught me that honesty is the best policy.
When faced with a tough decision, remember that honesty is the best policy.
